### [`v7.1.1`](https://redirect.github.com/facebook/react/blob/HEAD/packages/eslint-plugin-react-hooks/CHANGELOG.md#711)

**Note:** 7.1.0 accidentally removed the `component-hook-factories` rule, causing errors for users who referenced it in their ESLint config. This is now fixed.

- Add deprecated no-op `component-hook-factories` rule for backwards compatibility. ([@​mofeiZ](https://redirect.github.com/mofeiZ) in [#​36307](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/36307))

### [`v7.1.0`](https://redirect.github.com/facebook/react/blob/HEAD/packages/eslint-plugin-react-hooks/CHANGELOG.md#710)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/facebook/react/compare/408b38ef7304faf022d2a37110c57efce12c6bad...eslint-plugin-react-hooks@7.1.0)

This release adds ESLint v10 support, improves performance by skipping compilation for non-React files, and includes compiler lint improvements including better `set-state-in-effect` detection, improved ref validation, and more helpful error reporting.

- Add ESLint v10 support. ([@​azat-io](https://redirect.github.com/azat-io) in [#​35720](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35720))
- Skip compilation for non-React files to improve performance. ([@​josephsavona](https://redirect.github.com/josephsavona) in [#​35589](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35589))
- Fix exhaustive deps bug with Flow type casting. ([@​jorge-cab](https://redirect.github.com/jorge-cab) in [#​35691](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35691))
- Fix `useEffectEvent` checks in component syntax. ([@​jbrown215](https://redirect.github.com/jbrown215) in [#​35041](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35041))
- Improved `set-state-in-effect` validation with fewer false negatives. ([@​jorge-cab](https://redirect.github.com/jorge-cab) in [#​35134](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35134), [@​josephsavona](https://redirect.github.com/josephsavona) in [#​35147](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35147), [@​jackpope](https://redirect.github.com/jackpope) in [#​35214](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35214), [@​chesnokov-tony](https://redirect.github.com/chesnokov-tony) in [#​35419](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35419), [@​jsleitor](https://redirect.github.com/jsleitor) in [#​36107](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/36107))
- Improved ref validation for non-mutating functions and event handler props. ([@​josephsavona](https://redirect.github.com/josephsavona) in [#​35893](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35893), [@​kolvian](https://redirect.github.com/kolvian) in [#​35062](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35062))
- Compiler now reports all errors instead of stopping at the first. ([@​josephsavona](https://redirect.github.com/josephsavona) in [#​35873](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35873)–[#​35884](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35884))

##### New React DOM Features

- `browser()`: a new `react-dom` API that returns a usable which errors during server rendering and resolves in the browser. `use(browser())` inside a `<Suspense>` boundary marks a subtree as browser-only without reporting a recoverable error ([@​gnoff](https://redirect.github.com/gnoff): [#​37143](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/37143), [#​37241](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/37241))

##### Notable changes

- Enable Trusted Types API integration ([@​rickhanlonii](https://redirect.github.com/rickhanlonii) [#​35816](https://redirect.github.com/react/react/pull/35816))
